articles.titre: October new home sales 701k vs 650k
articles.resume: Prior was 676K (revised to 614K) The US Census Bureau and the Department of Housing and Urban Development publish the New Residential Sales report monthly at 10 am ET, usually in the last week of the month. It tracks sales of newly built single-family homes and is reported as a seasonally adjusted annualized rate. Unlike existing home sales, which count closings, new home sales are recorded when a contract is signed or a deposit is accepted. That makes the report a more timely gauge of housing demand, reflecting buyers' decisions in the reference month rather than one or two months earlier. articles.titre: Almost 60% of primary energy used for electricity is lost to conversion and transmission
articles.resume: In 2025, the United States consumed 34 quadrillion British thermal units (quads) of primary energy to deliver 14 quads of electricity sales to end users, with nearly 60% lost. About 95% of the losses came from converting primary energy into electricity, mostly due to lost heat from burning coal and natural gas. The remaining 5% was lost in the course of delivering electricity across grid infrastructure to homes and businesses.

articles.titre: Category 2 Hurricane Isaias nears landfall, leading to production shut-ins
articles.resume: As of 4:00 a.m. central time on October 9, the National Oceanic and Atmospheric Administration expects Hurricane Isaias to make landfall on the Gulf Coast late Friday or early Saturday, creating the potential for significant disruptions to energy infrastructure. Hurricane Isaias is the first hurricane of the 2026 Atlantic season and will be the largest storm system to make landfall in the region since Hurricane Helene in September 2024.
